name: Combinatorial Eluder Dimension / Proper Equivalence Queries
details: For every nonempty finite binary class, $\mathrm{Edim}\ge Q_{\mathrm{peq}}$. A learner that always proposes a currently consistent hypothesis meets this bound, including a possible successful final query; it stops once the target is uniquely identified.
proof_source: Full proof in the LaTeX survey: prop:proper-queries-eluder.
witness_verification: For n singletons plus the empty concept, combinatorial eluder dimension is n while proper equivalence queries equal one. The ratio is unbounded. See the database-owned endpoint proofs and sync/verify_upper_branch_comparisons.py.
